title: Track repair jobs in a bike shop
body: Mechanics and the counter see every repair job from drop-off to pickup.

title: Mechanics see their jobs for the day
body: Each mechanic sees the jobs assigned to them for today, in the order they are due.

title: Overdue jobs come first
body: A job past its due time is listed above the others and marked.

title: Show the day's jobs as one card per bike
body: A card shows the bike, the customer's name, the work to do and when it is due. Invoices are numbered per year.

title: Customers get a 12-month warranty slip with the invoice
body: The slip is printed together with the invoice at pickup.

title: A job note has at most 500 characters
body: Longer notes are refused when the job is saved.

title: A job has at most 20 parts
body: More parts are refused when the job is saved.

title: A photo has at most 10 MB
body: Larger photos are refused when the job is saved.

title: Customers know when their bike is ready
body: A customer learns that the repair is finished without calling the shop.

title: Text the customer when the bike is ready
body: No more calling customers one by one like we do now. The text goes out when the mechanic marks the job as done.

title: Print a QR tag for every bike so nobody mixes up two bikes
body: Each bike gets a printed tag with a QR code at drop-off.

title: Build the job list first, the texting later
body: The texting can wait until the job list works.
